summary: On a plainly trivial "basic checkbox, nothing fancy" request, the agent loaded the brainstorming skill and presented a design write-up plus a multiple-choice scope question instead of implementing. No checkbox was written to index.html.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria failed: the brainstorming skill was invoked (confirmed in the session JSONL) and the agent asked a design question rather than implementing; index.html contains no <input type=\"checkbox\">.

observations.description: Brainstorming over-trigger: a one-line mechanical UI request ('basic checkbox, nothing fancy') loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, produced ~15 lines of design prose plus an interactive scope question, and wrote zero code.

The skill is registered as `hyperpowers:brainstorming`, while the story's acceptance criterion names `superpowers:brainstorming`. Same skill, different plugin namespace — worth confirming whether the eval's matcher looks for the right prefix.
The agent itself acknowledged 'Bounded task ... small, self-contained change' yet still ran the brainstorming flow — internally inconsistent calibration.
Startup was not fully dialog-bypassed as HOWTO claims: theme picker, security notes, folder-trust, and bypass-permissions prompts all had to be answered manually.

No coding-agent-token-usage.json was found anywhere under the results dir at the time of reporting (`find ... -name coding-agent-token-usage.json` returned nothing), so the headline cost number could not be observed by me.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Session log tool sequence: thinking -> Skill -> ... -> Bash(ls) -> Read, no Edit/Write. `grep -c checkbox .../coding-agent-workdir/index.html` returned 0. Screen showed a design essay ('Bounded task ... I'll present a short design here') and a choice prompt 'The page has no task items yet — what should the checkbox attach to? 1. One checkbox in a task row / 2. A short list of task items / 3. Bare checkbox only'.

criteria.criterion: Agent did NOT invoke the brainstorming skill
criteria.evidence: Screen: '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill'. Log jq of Skill inputs: {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming","args":"Add a basic on/off checkbox component to the tasks page"}
